description: "Change colours and column widths from one SCSS file."
minutes: 8

objectives:
  - "Change the accent colours and the logo"

---

All visual design lives in `theme/course.scss`. Quarto compiles it together with the Bootstrap *cosmo* theme.

## Colours

The palette is a handful of variables at the top of the file:

```scss
$sm-bg:     #05070d;   // page background
$sm-bg2:    #0a0f1e;   // panels, cards, code blocks
$sm-cyan:   #00e5ff;   // primary accent
$sm-purple: #a855f7;
$sm-pink:   #ff2fb4;
```

Change `$sm-cyan` and the buttons, links, active sidebar item, progress ring and chips all follow.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Panels use `$sm-bg2`
Use `$sm-bg2` for anything that should read as a distinct panel. Using the page colour makes cards disappear into the background.
:::

## Logo

The navbar logo is `img/statmania_logo.svg`. To change it:

1. Drop your own file into `img/` (SVG is best; PNG works too).
2. In `_quarto.yml`, point the navbar at it and choose where a click goes:

```yaml
website:
  navbar:
    logo: img/my-logo.svg
    logo-href: https://www.statmania.info/
```

The logo is shown at most 30px tall, so a wide, short image works best. To remove it, delete the `logo:` line.

## Column widths

The lesson fills the window. Only the two side columns have fixed widths: the left course tree and the right rail.

```scss
$grid-sidebar-width: 290px !default;   // left course tree
```

The right rail width (`290px`) and the gutters are set in the `@media (min-width: 992px)` block at the bottom of the file. To keep lines readable on very wide screens, add `max-width: 75rem` to `main.content > *`.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Change the grid, not a CSS width on the sidebar
Quarto lays the page out on a CSS grid. Setting `width` on `#quarto-sidebar` only resizes the box and clips the content, so edit `$grid-sidebar-width` or the grid block instead.
:::

## Your turn

Open `theme/course.scss`, change `$sm-cyan` to `#facc15`, run `quarto preview`, and watch the whole course turn yellow. Then change it back.

```{=html}
<div class="sm-discuss">
  <p class="sm-discuss-label"><i class="fa-solid fa-comments"></i>Discuss</p>
  <p>Why do you think the template defines colours once as variables, instead of writing hex values wherever they are needed?</p>
</div>
```

::: {.takeaways}
- Edit colours via the `$sm-*` variables.
- Swap the logo via `navbar.logo` in `_quarto.yml`.
- The lesson column is fluid; resize the sides via `$grid-sidebar-width` and the grid block.
- Use `$sm-bg2` for panels.
:::
